title: Subsets II
description: Return all distinct subsets of a list that can contain repeated integers.
note: Sort the input, then skip the rest of an equal-value run when excluding an element.
notes: Both solutions sort the input in place so equal values are adjacent. The include branch advances one position, allowing a subset to use multiple copies of the same value.
After undoing the include choice, the exclude branch advances past the remaining copies of that value. Each possible count of an equal value is explored once.
At the end of each path, subset.copy() saves an independent result before later calls change the working list.
For n inputs, the worst case is O(n * 2^n) time and output space. The current subset and call stack use O(n) space, plus any workspace used by sorting.
